_comment: OPTIONAL override for anti-pattern-guard.cjs. Copy to anti-pattern-redirects.json and edit. If the file does not exist, the hook uses its built-in generic defaults (no project name, no project-specific commands).

buildArtifact.headline: Refusing to write into Hermes's build artifact directory.
buildArtifact.detail: release/<plat>-unpacked/ and app.asar.unpacked/ are regenerated by `hermes desktop --force-build`. Manual edits get clobbered on the next build and leave asar header metadata out of sync with actual unpacked contents (the cause of the 2026-07-30 `electron-main.mjs not found` chain).

hardcodedPid.headline: Refusing to Stop-Process on a hardcoded Hermes PID.
hardcodedPid.detail: PIDs change every launch. The workspace ships ready-made name-based kill scripts at the workspace root.
hardcodedPid.fix:
powershell -File "C:/Users/87999/claude-workspace/stop_hermes.ps1"   # graceful first
  powershell -File "C:/Users/87999/claude-workspace/kill_hermes.ps1"   # force if graceful fails
